The welfare lead on comfort stops
This section explains what the desk expects

Companion Animal Travel Desk Standards
The purpose of this section is to keep companion animal travel orderly, calm, and safe.

Staff must check travel papers, carrier condition, and feed instructions before handoff. Pets must stay with their assigned carrier unless a welfare review requires otherwise. The ground team handles each carrier with care and keeps movement steady between services. If a traveler arrives with a concern, staff should note it, respond plainly, and route the case through normal support. <<FACT F008>> No pet may be accepted without clear identification and suitable containment.

The desk also coordinates lounge use, cleaning, and transfer notes. <<FACT F023>> <<FACT F005>> Staff should keep the area quiet, watch for stress cues, and report any delay that affects welfare or boarding flow. Records must be complete, readable, and limited to the facts needed for service.

For escalations, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at Aurelia Skyways.
